gloss: the four classical arts: zither, Go, calligraphy, and painting

definitions.gloss: the four classical arts of the East Asian scholar
definitions.explanation: A four-character compound referring to the four traditional accomplishments of an educated person in classical East Asian culture: playing the {琴|きん} (the Chinese seven-string zither), the board game {棋|き} (Go), {書|しょ} (calligraphy), and {画|が} (painting).

examples.japanese: {琴棋書画|きんきしょが}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{文人|ぶんじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧たしなみだった。
examples.english: The four classical arts were the accomplishments of a man of letters.

examples.japanese: ⟦{江戸時代|えどじだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{文人|ぶんじん}たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{琴棋書画|きんきしょが}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しんだ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: Literati of the Edo period enjoyed the four classical arts.

examples.japanese: {琴棋書画|きんきしょが}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{古|ふる}く→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{屏風絵|びょうぶえ}→屏風絵：29405_byoubue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{題材|だいざい}→題材：10140_daizai⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{好|この}まれて→好む：02103_konomu⟧きた。
examples.english: The four classical arts have long been a favorite subject of folding-screen painting.

notes:
A literary four-character idiom (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧) imported from classical Chinese tradition. Each character names one of the four arts: {琴|きん} (zither), {棋|き} (Go), ⟦{書|しょ}→〜書：28467_sho⟧ (calligraphy), {画|が} (painting).

CULTURAL NOTE:
In premodern China and Japan, these four accomplishments were considered essential for a cultivated person, especially scholar-officials and members of the literati class. In Japan the four arts became a favorite subject of folding-screen and sliding-door painting.

REGISTER:
Literary and formal. Mostly encountered in writing about classical culture, art history, or traditional aesthetics rather than everyday speech.
